questions.prompt: Which race has drawn more outside money so far in the general election?
Groups helping Republicans have spent $1.4M in PA's 1st District House race. Are Republicans playing offense or defense?
questions.why: Republicans hold this seat now, so money helping Republicans here is defense.

questions.prompt: A party's coordinated spending in the last three weeks before Nov. 3 is disclosed when?
questions.why: Coordinated spending appears only on regular reports. Anything after Oct. 14 lands on the post-general report, due Dec. 3.

questions.prompt: CLF (a super PAC) has spent $1.8M in WA's 3rd District House race. Which party is it helping?
questions.why: Its spending supports the Republican or attacks their opponent. Every group's filings list who it backs or opposes.

questions.prompt: Groups helping Democrats have spent $1.8M in CA's 48th District House race. Are Democrats playing offense or defense?
questions.why: Republicans hold this seat now, so money helping Democrats here is offense.

questions.prompt: Which race has drawn more outside money so far in the general election?
AB PAC (a super PAC) has spent $366K in NC's 9th District House race. Which party is it helping?
questions.why: Its spending supports the Democrat or attacks their opponent. Every group's filings list who it backs or opposes.

questions.prompt: In the final 60 days, who pays less for the same TV spot?
questions.why: Stations must sell candidates airtime at the lowest unit charge. Outside groups pay market rates, which climb near Election Day.

questions.prompt: In SC's 1st District House race, outside money favors Republicans by $1.1M. Whose nominee has raised more?
questions.why: Outside money and candidate money point opposite ways here: the Democrat leads fundraising by $1.7M.

questions.prompt: Can a super PAC give $10,000 directly to a House candidate's campaign?
questions.why: Super PACs can raise unlimited money but can't give to candidates or coordinate with them. They can only spend independently.
